Each Episode, as you master the Seasonal Artifact, you will earn access to powerful Artifact perks as you collect experience.

Continue walking the Path of Resolve, hone your Taken power, and draw forth the Tome of Want from the Shaping Slab.

This powerful relic will further increase your potential, steel your mind against corruption, and repurpose the shape of desire into the shape of being.

entries.title: Act III: Crossed Blades
entries.body:
"My proud sister reduced to this," Oryx laughs.

He is simultaneously pleased by the triumph of his presumptive heir and disappointed by the defeat of his sister.

"My sisters are now hollow. Blunted…"

Oryx considers his role in what has become of the Hive pantheon.

"So, you have forestalled Xivu Arath. Her ritual scatters. This throne world and its chains stand."
